$comment: Hand-written source of truth for breaking changes. `from`/`to` name components that must resolve in the registry; the generator injects their props tables so the migration guide can never drift from the code.

releases.summary: First published cut of the shared component library: the `ui/` primitives became the documented public surface.

changes.title: Button replaced CommonButton
changes.summary: `components/common/Button` is superseded by `components/ui/Button`. `variant="primary"` became `variant="default"`, the `loading` prop folded into the native `disabled` attribute, and a `size` prop was added.
notes: `CommonButton` set `disabled` whenever `loading` was true, so the disabled mapping preserves behaviour exactly.
Update the import path as well as the JSX: `components/common/Button/Button` → `components/ui/Button`.

releases.summary: Pre-library baseline: status indicators were styled per screen and shared no API.

changes.title: Ad-hoc status pills replaced by Badge
changes.summary: Per-screen pill markup was consolidated into `Badge`, which owns the colour variants and the audited contrast pairings. The previous `badge--green` / `badge--red` classes were removed.
notes: `Badge` has no `size` prop — density is inherited from the surrounding text.
Colour is never the only signal: keep a text label inside the pill (WEB-38 / #492).
